title: Providers

panels.description: Collector and T3 source health; the pools below are only as fresh as this strip.

targets.expr: max by (source, status, reason, field) (label_replace((ghostship_ai_source_status{source=~"t3|t3_usage|opencode-go"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_source_status{source=~"t3|t3_usage|opencode-go"}) == on(source) group_left max by (source) (timestamp(ghostship_ai_source_status{source=~"t3|t3_usage|opencode-go"})))), "field", "info", "", "") or label_replace(ghostship_ai_collection_timestamp_seconds, "field", "collected", "", ""))

options.content: {{#each (sourceHealth data (variable "__to"))}}{{this.name}} · {{this.text}}{{/each}}
options.defaultContent: Collector readings missing · check collector service

panels.description: Latest provider readings and the original T3 daily token and price-cost buckets that start inside the time range (server.getUsageSummary, up to 30 days; never repriced here). Confirmed or explicit Codex resets come from the reset tracker.

targets.expr:
max by (account, kind, quota_id, label, evidence, provider, state, basis, reason, not_used, field) (
          label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_remaining_ratio{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_remaining_ratio{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "left", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_expected_remaining_ratio{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_expected_remaining_ratio{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "expected", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_reset_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_reset_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "resetAt", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "checked", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_rolling{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_rolling{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "rolling", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_order{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_order{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "order", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_learning{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_learning{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "learning", "", "")
          or label_replace(ghostship_ai_provider_free_models{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}",provider!="openrouter",provider!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_provider_free_models{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}",provider!="openrouter",provider!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "free_models", "", "")
         or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_state{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_state{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "pace_state", "", "") or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_availability{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_availability{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "availability", "", "") or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_availability_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_availability_check_timestamp_seconds{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "availability_checked", "", "")
)
 or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_delta_points{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_pace_delta_points{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "pace_delta", "", "")
 or label_replace(ghostship_ai_account_window_missing{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"} and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_account_window_missing{account=~"${paid_account:regex}",account!="openrouter",account!="pi",account!="openrouter",account!="pi"}) > scalar(max(timestamp(ghostship_ai_collection_duration_seconds))) - 90), "field", "reported_missing", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_tokens{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}",kind="total"} and on(provider,model,day) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} >= $__from / 1000 and ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} <= $__to / 1000)), "field", "usage_tokens", "", ""), "account", "$1", "provider", "(.+)")
 or label_replace(label_replace((ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_cost_usd{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} and on(provider,model,day) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} >= $__from / 1000 and ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} <= $__to / 1000)), "field", "usage_cost", "", ""), "account", "$1", "provider", "(.+)")
 or label_replace(label_replace((ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_unpriced_records{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} and on(provider,model,day) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} >= $__from / 1000 and ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds{provider=~"${paid_account:regex}"} <= $__to / 1000)), "field", "usage_unpriced", "", ""), "account", "$1", "provider", "(.+)")
 or label_replace(label_replace(ghostship_ai_announced_reset_info{scope="codex",confidence=~"confirmed|high"}, "account", "codex", "", ""), "field", "announced", "", "")

panels.title: Evidence · T3 usage by model, reset announcements, source health
T3 tokens and price cost by model
panels.description: T3 usage-page totals (input + cached input + cache writes + output; reasoning is part of output) and T3 costUsd for every day that starts inside the time range. Unpriced records stay unpriced, never zero.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, model) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_tokens{kind="total"} and on(provider,model,day) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds >= $__from / 1000 and ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds <= $__to / 1000))

sum by (provider, model) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_cost_usd and on(provider,model,day) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds >= $__from / 1000 and ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds <= $__to / 1000))

sum by (provider, model) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_unpriced_records and on(provider,model,day) (ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds >= $__from / 1000 and ghostship_ai_t3_usage_bucket_timestamp_seconds <= $__to / 1000))

panels.title: Reset announcements
panels.description: Unverified announcements remain visible with provenance and require confirmation before changing pacing.

targets.expr: max by (source_url, confidence, label, scope, reset_at) (ghostship_ai_announced_reset_info) or label_replace(absent(ghostship_ai_announced_reset_info), "label", "No reset announcement events yet", "", "")
ghostship_ai_source_status and (timestamp(ghostship_ai_source_status) == on(source) group_left max by (source) (timestamp(ghostship_ai_source_status)))

description: Providers in two pools, Paid and Free: capacity, next reset, confirmed reset events and T3 token and price cost.
